import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                      c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='RdYlGn_r', 
                      alpha=0.7, s=50, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality\n(colored by Stress Level)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1)
cbar.set_label('Stress Level', fontsize=10)

# Plot 2: Box plot of Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
occupation_order = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].median().sort_values().index
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Occupation', y='Sleep Duration', ax=ax2, palette='viridis', order=occupation_order)
ax2.set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Sleep Duration by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Plot 3: Relationship between Physical Activity and Sleep Quality by Gender
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
for gender in df['Gender'].unique():
    subset = df[df['Gender'] == gender]
    ax3.scatter(subset['Physical Activity Level'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
                label=gender, alpha=0.6, s=50)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level (minutes/day)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Physical Activity vs Sleep Quality by Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Gender')

# Add trend line
z = np.polyfit(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 1)
p = np.poly1d(z)
import numpy as np
x_line = np.linspace(df['Physical Activity Level'].min(), df['Physical Activity Level'].max(), 100)
ax3.plot(x_line, p(x_line), "r--", alpha=0.8, label='Trend')

# Plot 4: Sleep Disorder distribution with average metrics
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Fill NaN in Sleep Disorder with 'None'
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
disorder_stats = df.groupby('Sleep Disorder').agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean',
    'Stress Level': 'mean'
}).reset_index()

x = np.arange(len(disorder_stats))
width = 0.25

bars1 = ax4.bar(x - width, disorder_stats['Sleep Duration'], width, label='Avg Sleep Duration (hrs)', color='steelblue')
bars2 = ax4.bar(x, disorder_stats['Quality of Sleep'], width, label='Avg Sleep Quality', color='forestgreen')
bars3 = ax4.bar(x + width, disorder_stats['Stress Level'], width, label='Avg Stress Level', color='coral')

ax4.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Average Value', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Average Metrics by Sleep Disorder Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xticks(x)
ax4.set_xticklabels(disorder_stats['Sleep Disorder'])
ax4.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=9)

# Add value labels on bars
for bars in [bars1, bars2, bars3]:
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        ax4.annotate(f'{height:.1f}',
                    xy=(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, height),
                    xytext=(0, 3),
                    textcoords="offset points",
                    ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
